tracking.getBarcodeLocations.description: Returns the labware and well each barcode is currently tracked at.

tracking.getLabwareDetails.description: Returns the tracked barcode, volume, state and position of labware and its wells.

tracking.setBarcodes.description: Assigns barcodes to labware and to individual wells.

tracking.setLabwareVolume.description: Sets the tracked liquid volume of labware and of individual wells.
